answer: For Siemens Group, the SBTi fiscal-2030 targets use fiscal 2019 as baseline: Scope 1 and 2 are to fall 90% from 938 ktCO2e and had fallen 62% by fiscal 2025; Scope 3 is to fall 30% from 179,222 ktCO2e and had fallen 11%. For Siemens excluding Siemens Healthineers, the corresponding targets are 90% from 691 ktCO2e with 66% achieved, and 30% from 174,558 ktCO2e with 11% achieved. Scope 2 uses the market-based method, biogenic CO2 is excluded, the targets cover the complete value chain and all own sites worldwide, and the Siemens-without-SHS baseline was adjusted in fiscal 2025 for material structural changes under GHG Protocol guidance.

normalized_value.coverage: complete value chain, all own sites worldwide and all GHGs under GHG Protocol
normalized_value.baseline_adjustment: Siemens w/o SHS baseline adjusted in fiscal 2025 for material structural changes under GHG Protocol guidance
